title: Score Search Results
description: Scores and filters search results based on progressive partial/exact matching. Can return dictionaries or a parallel list of formatted strings.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: List of 3 to 5 columns -> [results, suppliers, part_codes, mpns (optional), descriptions (optional)].

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Output column for the dictionaries. If a list of 2 is provided, outputs [dicts_column, pretty_strings_column].

parameters.name: must_match_part_code
parameters.description: If true, filters out results that don't satisfy the allowed match types.

parameters.name: allow_mpn_exact
parameters.description: Treat exact MPN matches as valid part code matches.

parameters.name: allow_mpn_partial
parameters.description: Treat partial MPN matches as valid part code matches.

parameters.name: allow_other_exact
parameters.description: Treat exact other part code matches as valid part code matches.

parameters.name: allow_other_partial
parameters.description: Treat partial other part code matches as valid part code matches.

parameters.name: blacklist_keywords
parameters.description: Comma-separated list or array of keywords to filter out URLs containing them.

parameters.name: mpn_exact_score
parameters.description: Mpn Exact Score value accepted by the runtime.

parameters.name: mpn_partial_base
parameters.description: Mpn Partial Base value accepted by the runtime.

parameters.name: part_code_exact_score
parameters.description: Part Code Exact Score value accepted by the runtime.

parameters.name: part_code_partial_base
parameters.description: Part Code Partial Base value accepted by the runtime.

parameters.name: supplier_exact_score
parameters.description: Supplier Exact Score value accepted by the runtime.

parameters.name: supplier_partial_base
parameters.description: Supplier Partial Base value accepted by the runtime.

parameters.name: context_match_base
parameters.description: Context Match Base value accepted by the runtime.

parameters.name: fuzzy_match_threshold
parameters.description: Fuzzy Match Threshold value accepted by the runtime.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Scores and filters search results based on progressive partial/exact matching. Can return dictionaries or a parallel list of formatted strings. ## Migrated examples #### Rank Part Search Results This template scores search results using supplier and part-code context. The fields added to each result dictionary depend on the scoring configuration. ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - compute.score_search_results: input: - Search Results - Suppliers - Part Codes output: - Scored Results allow_other_exact: true must_match_part_code: true ```
##### Input Sample | Search Results | Suppliers | Part Codes | | --- | --- | --- | | `[{"title": "SKF 6202 bearing", "link": "https://example.com/6202"}]` | `["SKF"]` | `["6202"]` |
##### Output Sample | Search Results | Suppliers | Part Codes | Scored Results | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `[{"title": "SKF 6202 bearing", "link": "https://example.com/6202"}]` | `["SKF"]` | `["6202"]` | Ranked result dictionaries |
_Template based on the documented parameters; no published source example is currently available._
